senses.gloss: adv. (= נְהֵי מִי; cmp. ויהי מה II Sam. XVIII, 23) at all events, really, even, likewise.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 102a:4-5">Pes. 102ᵃ</cite> <he>נימא ניהוי תיובתיה נ׳ מהא</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>נימא מהא נ׳ תיהוי תיובתא</he>) I mean to say, at all events (even if the previous objection could be met) he will stand refuted from this citation; <cite ref="Eruvin 30a:15">Erub. 30ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Pesachim 114a:7">Pes. 114ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>הכא נ׳</he> (abbrev. <he>ה״נ</he>), v. <cite ref="E00499"><he>הָכָא</he></cite>.

Yoma 64ᵃ נהי נ׳, v. נְהֵי II.—הכי נ׳ (abbrev. ה״נ) it is really so; is it really so? Ḥag. 11ᵇ ה״נ will you say, it is really so (that this subject must be taught only in the presence of three students)? Ḥull. 11ᵇ sq. ה״נ דלא וכ׳ (will you say) it is really so that he ate no meat?; וכי תימא ה״נ וכ׳ and if you will say, ‘yes, it is so’, what about sacred meat? Ib. 12ᵃ אפי׳ תרומה נ׳ then you must say ‘yes’ even with regard to T’rumah; אפי׳ שחיטה נ׳ לא then you must say ‘no’ even with regard to slaughtering. Ib. אי נ׳ שמע אינש אחרינא Rashi (ed. incorr.) even if another person did overhear it. Ib. 51ᵃ והאי נ׳ וכ׳ and this animal has really measured its strength.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 98a:7">B. Mets. 98ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>אי נ׳</he> or indeed (which would be better).—
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 22b:16">R. Hash. 22ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>הכי נ׳ מסתברא</he> so, indeed, it stands to reason.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 22b:16">Ib.</cite>, a. fr. <he>תניא נ׳ הכי</he> so, indeed, it has been taught.
<cite ref="Berakhot 4b:12">Ber. 4ᵇ</cite> <he>מה קימה … אף שכיבה נ׳ וכ׳</he> as on getting up you must recite …, so on lying down likewise &c.; a. v. fr.
